mapper.select:
select bn.notice_title, bn.notice_description, bn.start_date from brd_notice bn where 1=1
and (bn.notice_title like concat('%', #{searchKeyword}, '%') or bn.notice_description like concat('%', #{searchKeyword}, '%'))
and bn.sys_plant_cd = #{sysPlantCd} and bn.delete_yn = 'N'
mapper.insert: insert into brd_notice ( sys_id, notice_title, notice_description, start_date, delete_yn, use_yn, file_ulid, insert_user_id, insert_datetime, sys_plant_cd ) values ( #{noticeRequest.sysId}, #{noticeRequest.noticeTitle}, #{noticeRequest.noticeDescription}, #{noticeRequest.startDate}, 'N', #{noticeRequest.useYn}, #{noticeRequest.fileUuid}, #{userId}, now(), #{sysPlantCd} )
mapper.update: update brd_notice set notice_title = #{noticeRequest.noticeTitle}, notice_description = #{noticeRequest.noticeDescription}, start_date = #{noticeRequest.startDate}, use_yn = #{noticeRequest.useYn}, modify_user_id = #{userId}, modify_datetime = now() where 1=1 and sys_id = #{noticeRequest.sysId}
mapper.delete: update brd_notice set delete_yn = 'Y' where 1=1 and sys_id in
mapper.select: select bn.notice_title, bn.notice_description, bn.start_date from brd_notice bn where 1=1 and bn.sys_id = #{sysId} and bn.delete_yn = 'N'
